name: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim
label: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim
description: OpenStreetMap / Nominatim official API via OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). Operations: nominatim_search, nominatim_reverse, nominatim_lookup. Docs: https://nominatim.org/release-docs/latest/api/Overview/. OSMF Nominatim usage policy: max ~1 req/s, identifying UA, ODbL attribution. Do not automate public nominatim.openstreetmap.org as a generic platform geocoder. Set nominatim_host to a host you are allowed to use (self-hosted or commercial). No autocomplete. Do not scrape OSM tiles/HTML. Secrets stay in configurationParameters. jobType custom-script-executor.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One OpenStreetMap / Nominatim request. Set operation plus the fields that operation requires. Delivered as inputVariables.input. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"nominatim_search"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official HTTP operation to run. EXACT values: nominatim_search | nominatim_reverse | nominatim_lookup. Default: first listed or instance operation. Example: 'nominatim_search'.

schema.label: addressdetails
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `addressdetails` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: countrycodes
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `countrycodes` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `email` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lat
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lat` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: limit
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `limit` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: lon
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `lon` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: nominatim_host
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `nominatim_host` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: osm_ids
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `osm_ids` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: q
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `q` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

schema.label: zoom
schema.description: Sent as path, query, or JSON body field `zoom` for the selected operation. Omit when unused. Do not put secrets here.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Secrets never echoed. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body (or raw text if not JSON). Never includes the API secret.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is omitted. EXACT: nominatim_search, nominatim_reverse, nominatim_lookup.

configurationParameters.label: Nominatim Host
configurationParameters.description: Nominatim host you are allowed to query (no scheme). Example: nominatim.example.com. Do not use nominatim.openstreetmap.org as a generic platform geocoder.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout seconds. Default 25. Keep under the daemon sandbox request budget.
